name: Jigorou
source:
A magic user that came from the magical world due to varies circumstances. 
He's the perpetrator that one that gave me the power to see through thing, occasionally he'll help me with his magic in transformation, arousal, etc... 
I looks like that we'll have to do good deeds together or else he can't go back. 
With his mysterious power, he can't be seen by the people around him.

[From barachan]
